config.name: RFO timeline, from the cell counters and core probes
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT concat(toString(dateDiff('minute', started, now())), ' min ago') AS "Started",
       if(ended >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE, 'ongoing', concat(toString(dateDiff('minute', ended, now())), ' min ago')) AS "Ended",
       dateDiff('minute', started, ended) AS "Minutes",
       what AS "What",
       place AS "Where",
       evidence AS "Evidence"
FROM (
  SELECT min(_timestamp) AS started, max(_timestamp) + INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AS ended, 'RSRP drop' AS what, concat(cell, ' on ', site) AS place,
         concat('RSRP down to ', toString(round(min(rsrp), 1)), ' dBm from a normal ', toString(round(any(rsrp_base), 1))) AS evidence
  FROM (SELECT k._timestamp AS _timestamp, k.cell AS cell, k.site AS site, k.rsrp AS rsrp, b.rsrp_base AS rsrp_base, k.users AS users,
         k.dl / greatest(k.users, 1) / b.rate_base AS rate_ratio,
         k.rsrp < b.rsrp_base - 8 AS rsrp_drop,
         k.dl / greatest(k.users, 1) < 0.25 * b.rate_base AND k.rsrp >= b.rsrp_base - 3 AS collapse
  FROM (SELECT _timestamp, toString(_json.cell) AS cell, toString(_json.site) AS site, toFloat64(_json.rsrp_dbm) AS rsrp, toFloat64(_json.dl_throughput_mbps) AS dl, toFloat64(_json.active_users) AS users FROM dfe.`ran-kpis` WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp)) AS k
  INNER JOIN (SELECT toString(_json.cell) AS cell, median(toFloat64(_json.rsrp_dbm)) AS rsrp_base, median(toFloat64(_json.dl_throughput_mbps) / greatest(toFloat64(_json.active_users), 1)) AS rate_base FROM dfe.`ran-kpis` GROUP BY cell) AS b ON k.cell = b.cell)
  WHERE rsrp_drop
  GROUP BY cell, site
  UNION ALL
  SELECT min(_timestamp), max(_timestamp) + INTERVAL 5 MINUTE, 'Throughput collapse', concat(cell, ' on ', site),
         concat('Mbps per user down to ', toString(round(100 * min(rate_ratio))), '% of normal with RSRP normal and ', toString(round(avg(users))), ' users still attached')
  FROM (SELECT k._timestamp AS _timestamp, k.cell AS cell, k.site AS site, k.rsrp AS rsrp, b.rsrp_base AS rsrp_base, k.users AS users,
         k.dl / greatest(k.users, 1) / b.rate_base AS rate_ratio,
         k.rsrp < b.rsrp_base - 8 AS rsrp_drop,
         k.dl / greatest(k.users, 1) < 0.25 * b.rate_base AND k.rsrp >= b.rsrp_base - 3 AS collapse
  FROM (SELECT _timestamp, toString(_json.cell) AS cell, toString(_json.site) AS site, toFloat64(_json.rsrp_dbm) AS rsrp, toFloat64(_json.dl_throughput_mbps) AS dl, toFloat64(_json.active_users) AS users FROM dfe.`ran-kpis` WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp)) AS k
  INNER JOIN (SELECT toString(_json.cell) AS cell, median(toFloat64(_json.rsrp_dbm)) AS rsrp_base, median(toFloat64(_json.dl_throughput_mbps) / greatest(toFloat64(_json.active_users), 1)) AS rate_base FROM dfe.`ran-kpis` GROUP BY cell) AS b ON k.cell = b.cell)
  WHERE collapse
  GROUP BY cell, site
  UNION ALL
  SELECT started, ended, 'Cell silent', concat(cell, ' on ', site), 'no PM counters reported'
  FROM (SELECT cell, site, previous + INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AS started, _timestamp AS ended
  FROM (SELECT _timestamp, toString(_json.cell) AS cell, toString(_json.site) AS site,
               lagInFrame(_timestamp, 1, toDateTime64(0, 3, 'UTC')) OVER (PARTITION BY cell ORDER BY _timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS previous
        FROM dfe.`ran-kpis` WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp))
  WHERE toUnixTimestamp(previous) > 0 AND dateDiff('second', previous, _timestamp) > 360)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT min(minute), max(minute) + INTERVAL 1 MINUTE, concat(procedure, ' failure burst'), concat('core, ', any(interface)),
         concat(toString(sum(failures)), ' of ', toString(sum(attempts)), ' attempts failed, mostly ', any(cause), ', p95 up to ', toString(round(max(p95))), ' ms')
  FROM (SELECT toStartOfMinute(_timestamp) AS minute, toString(_json.procedure) AS procedure, toString(_json.interface) AS interface,
         count() AS attempts, countIf(toString(_json.result) = 'failure') AS failures, topKIf(1)(toString(_json.cause), toString(_json.result) = 'failure')[1] AS cause, quantile(0.95)(toFloat64(_json.latency_ms)) AS p95
  FROM dfe.`core-probes` WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp)
  GROUP BY minute, procedure, interface
  HAVING attempts >= 5 AND failures > 0.25 * attempts)
  GROUP BY procedure)
ORDER BY started

config.name: Fault signals over time
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT ts, signal, count() AS "signals"
FROM (
  SELECT $__timeInterval(_timestamp) AS ts, if(rsrp_drop, 'RSRP drop', 'Throughput collapse') AS signal FROM (SELECT k._timestamp AS _timestamp, k.cell AS cell, k.site AS site, k.rsrp AS rsrp, b.rsrp_base AS rsrp_base, k.users AS users,
         k.dl / greatest(k.users, 1) / b.rate_base AS rate_ratio,
         k.rsrp < b.rsrp_base - 8 AS rsrp_drop,
         k.dl / greatest(k.users, 1) < 0.25 * b.rate_base AND k.rsrp >= b.rsrp_base - 3 AS collapse
  FROM (SELECT _timestamp, toString(_json.cell) AS cell, toString(_json.site) AS site, toFloat64(_json.rsrp_dbm) AS rsrp, toFloat64(_json.dl_throughput_mbps) AS dl, toFloat64(_json.active_users) AS users FROM dfe.`ran-kpis` WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp)) AS k
  INNER JOIN (SELECT toString(_json.cell) AS cell, median(toFloat64(_json.rsrp_dbm)) AS rsrp_base, median(toFloat64(_json.dl_throughput_mbps) / greatest(toFloat64(_json.active_users), 1)) AS rate_base FROM dfe.`ran-kpis` GROUP BY cell) AS b ON k.cell = b.cell) WHERE rsrp_drop OR collapse
  UNION ALL
  SELECT $__timeInterval(started), 'Cell silent' FROM (SELECT cell, site, previous + INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AS started, _timestamp AS ended
  FROM (SELECT _timestamp, toString(_json.cell) AS cell, toString(_json.site) AS site,
               lagInFrame(_timestamp, 1, toDateTime64(0, 3, 'UTC')) OVER (PARTITION BY cell ORDER BY _timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS previous
        FROM dfe.`ran-kpis` WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp))
  WHERE toUnixTimestamp(previous) > 0 AND dateDiff('second', previous, _timestamp) > 360)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT $__timeInterval(minute), 'Probe failure burst' FROM (SELECT toStartOfMinute(_timestamp) AS minute, toString(_json.procedure) AS procedure, toString(_json.interface) AS interface,
         count() AS attempts, countIf(toString(_json.result) = 'failure') AS failures, topKIf(1)(toString(_json.cause), toString(_json.result) = 'failure')[1] AS cause, quantile(0.95)(toFloat64(_json.latency_ms)) AS p95
  FROM dfe.`core-probes` WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp)
  GROUP BY minute, procedure, interface
  HAVING attempts >= 5 AND failures > 0.25 * attempts))
GROUP BY ts, signal
ORDER BY ts
